description:
Create a custom point style for populated places using an external SVG graphic.

1. Create an SVG file named 'star.svg' containing a star icon with a yellow fill (#FFFF00) and black stroke.
2. Upload this SVG file to GeoServer (globally or in the 'ne' workspace).
3. Create a new style named 'star_marker' that uses this 'star.svg' as an ExternalGraphic for point symbolization. Set the size to approx 16-24px.
4. specific the 'ne_populated_places' layer to use 'star_marker' as its default style.

GeoServer Admin: http://localhost:8080/geoserver/web/ (admin / Admin123!)
